research_track: QTR-01 Trace Model Associations, not WSP substrate, Knowledge Associations, or Weight Programming
question: Can a tokenless native structure-discovery learner form and retain a causally useful explanation of an unseen compositional law that is functionally absent from its initial source-law bank, and generalize to unseen intervention sequences better than the strongest equally informed trained conventional or Bayesian control?

predecessor.reason: F48 one-hot actions reveal 8 index bits and identify the preset candidate; native 16-observation 88.55% trails random 94.44%; no scientific superiority.

task.public_input: Each intervention supplies an ordered two-step trajectory of 8 binary intervention bits per step and 2 binary context bits fixed for the trajectory. Both resulting public binary outcomes are observable; previous action is zero in the first step. No hidden AST/law ID, target label, outcome from another trial, or future step is shown to any learner.
task.source_training: For each source-bank size, generate that many distinct depth <=2 source ASTs using SHA256 namespace F49/source/v1; only leaves a[0..7], previous_action[0..7], context[0..1], Boolean AND/OR/XOR/NOT are allowed. Evaluate exactly 64 predetermined two-step training trajectories per source AST, SHA256 namespace F49/train/v1. All arms see identical complete TRAIN-source action/outcome sequences, program vocabulary, and causal primitives. Target laws are excluded from every source bank and TRAIN trajectories. No learning from reserved evaluation worlds.
task.heldout_target_generator: At each (bank size, development seed), SHA256(F49/target/v1|bank_size|seed) chooses leaf indices and signs with deterministic rejection of repeated leaves. Seed 163: y=(a_i AND (a_j XOR a_k)) XOR (context_0 AND a_l). Seed 167: y=(a_i AND previous_action_j) XOR (a_k XOR context_1). Seed 173: y=(context_0 ? (a_i XOR a_j) : (a_k AND a_l)) XOR (context_1 AND previous_action_m). Indices i,j,k,l,m are distinct in [0,7]. Outcome of each step is calculated with previous_action set to the preceding step's bits. No target AST/ID is provided to any arm, even during source training.
task.source_bank_and_target_admission: The evaluator verifies source programs are functionally distinct and every target is functionally absent from its source bank over an evaluator-only canonical probe covering both context bits, immediate and delayed action interactions; reject TASK_INVALID on failure without regenerating, changing seed, or reporting a positive. Reject if one-hot-only or repeated same-action query identifies the target uniquely by trivial direct ID code. No F48 index-encoded direct pathway is permitted.
task.noise: Public source and target outcomes independently flip with a deterministic SHA256(F49/obs/v1|world|trajectory|step|replicate) event when the first 64 PRF bits are less than floor(2^64/10), giving 10% bit-flip noise. Clean counterfactual truth is evaluator-only.
task.queries: Fixed public query candidate pool of 256 distinct, nontrivial, two-step action-context trajectories per world from F49/queries/v1; all arms have identical candidates. Budget checkpoints high first [32,16,8] trajectory queries; exactly 2 public outcome bits per query. Choose adaptively only from public outcomes already observed. No hidden-evaluator feedback or free extra public query.
task.evaluation: 256 distinct evaluator-only counterfactual two-step trajectories per world from disjoint F49/eval/v1 namespace; exclude all public queried trajectories and TRAIN-source trajectories. Evaluate both clean step outcomes; report counterfactual binary prediction accuracy and Brier score using identical evaluator for all arms. Evaluator must never use a hidden AST as a model feature.
task.reserved_unopened: All seeds outside the three development seeds, including 179 and 181, and any WSP99 protected/public reserved cohorts remain unqueried and unimplemented for F49. No protected scientific first-use.

arms.native: Tokenless bounded direct discrete rule construction: initialize without any target-law AST/ID, update from public outcomes only, search depth<=4 Boolean grammar using a deterministic maximum of 1024 proposed AST expansions per observed trajectory with mismatch-penalty plus description-length tie-break, and retain local integer evidence plus exact cold checkpoint. No gradient updates or donor hidden states.
arms.conventional_mlp: Fully train a two-hidden-layer 64x64 ReLU Bernoulli predictor on the identical TRAIN-source observations; fixed Adam learning rate 0.001, batch 128, maximum 200 epochs, TRAIN-only 10% validation, patience 20, seed 11. For adaptation, use only the same budgeted target outcomes and 16 bounded optimizer steps per new trajectory. Include all pretraining and adaptation in cost.
arms.conventional_logistic: Fully train regularized Bernoulli logistic regression on the same TRAIN-source observations, fixed L2=0.001, deterministic LBFGS or explicit full-batch solver, maximum 500 iterations and tolerance 1e-8; refit on only public target outcomes under the same query budgets. Include all training in cost.
arms.exact_bank_bayes: Exact 10% observation-noise posterior over all 1024/512/256 known source-bank ASTs; deterministic maximum-entropy intervention selection from the same public query pool; no target identity oracle. Track every candidate evaluation and all cost.
arms.compositional_bayes: Bayesian grammar-search control over the same permitted Boolean primitives up to depth 4; 1024 proposed AST expansions per observed trajectory, Bernoulli 0.1 likelihood, prior exp(-1.5*AST node count), posterior predictive policy, no target AST oracle.
arms.random: Independent deterministic PRF-sampled selection from the same public query pool, trained native evaluator; no target labels.
arms.uniform: Deterministic cyclic query selection from the same public query pool, trained native evaluator; no target labels.
ablations: native random rule proposals with equal 1024-expansion budget

fairness.report_complete_cost: Training+adaptation+selection+evaluation time on the same declared hardware/OS plus candidate prediction accesses, AST proposals, peak RAM, checkpoint bytes, data observations and total CPU-seconds. Equal actions alone do not mean equal compute.
fairness.allowed_runtime: CPU, pinned Python and dependency versions, deterministic PRF; Windows and Ubuntu qualification separately. No GPU required, paid inference, web fetching, live controller, queue or scheduler.

prereg_metrics.primary: Mean over nine DEV worlds of unqueried two-step intervention accuracy at budget 16. Compare native with the maximum score achieved by any one of MLP, logistic, exact-bank Bayes, compositional Bayes, uniform and random, using their own equally budgeted queries.
prereg_metrics.negative_controls: Action/outcome permutation and null-action policies must not be awarded causal-discovery credit; adversarial malformed queries rejected; a genuine additional outcome on a separated clone may update that clone only. Report if any negative control unexpectedly performs comparably; do not silently retune.
prereg_metrics.admission: If all arms exceed 95% B16 or the best conventional control is below 55% B16, classify TASK_HEADROOM_INVALID rather than GOOD/BAD, preserve evidence and stop. Do not reseed or change world construction after viewing outcomes.
prereg_metrics.decision: DEV_F49_GO only if every requirement passes and task is admitted; otherwise DEV_F49_NO_GO or TASK_INVALID. No post-outcome parameter or threshold tuning. Nine development worlds cannot establish SCIENTIFIC_PASS; disjoint independent qualification, stronger controls if found, and separate main-model acceptance are mandatory.

custody.freeze_commit: This JSON must be committed alone before world implementation or observation. The frozen blob identity is the Git tree blob SHA, never edited after results.
custody.implementation_contract: Before any first DEV outcome, implementation and its tests must enforce this exact prereg blob and pin known source paths. Implementation deficiencies are infrastructure failures, never retroactive science improvements.
custody.first_use: No protected cohorts, WSP99 reserved/public worlds, hidden evaluator future labels, external dataset, or accepted native weight edits. First use of a protected evaluation cohort requires its own independent recorded authorization and custody.
